newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita still a hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it maintains its hold rating on Brazilian steelmaker Acesita but believes the stock "is attractive at the current trading price range, making it a good speculative buying opportunity."
-- "We remain holders of Acesita," analyst Mauricio Reveco said in a report.
-- Acesita's reported first quarter earnings of $21.8 million, versus a $23.2 million loss in the same period last year were above expectations, he said.
-- The company's net revenue was 18.4 percent lower than 1996's first quarter but Acesita also has sharply reduced losses in the first quarter, Reveco wrote.
-- Export shipments decreased but domestic shipments were much stronger in the period compared with a year earlier.
-- The company is currently expanding its stainless steel capacity to an added 130,000 tonnes by 1998.
-- "We are optimistic for 1997 results, particularly given stainless steel prices appear to have stabilized and ... should experience a recovery by 1998," Reveco wrote.
-- Acesita common closed off 0.87 percent at 2.27 reais while its preferred ended off 2.54 percent at 2.30 reais in Sao Paulo.
